query:
SELECT r.id, r.state, r.district, r.office, r.primary_date, r.general_date, r.status, r.called_winner_party,
       c.id as cand_id, c.name, c.party, c.incumbent, c.votes, c.pct, c.winner
FROM house_races r
LEFT JOIN candidates c ON c.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.state = 'WV' AND r.district = 2
ORDER BY c.party, c.name;
